name: trainer-desk
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi; sed -i "s/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/" .env; sed -i "s|^DB_DATABASE=.*|DB_DATABASE=database/database.sqlite|" .env; mkdir -p database; touch database/database.sqlite; composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist; npm install'
